adopted_text_witness.project_transcription: The whitespace-free text is assembled from the 31-clause table in docs/STATUS.md; it was not copied from the external CBETA XML file.
adopted_text_witness.normalization: Exact UTF-8 bytes, no BOM, one final LF, no punctuation or spaces
adopted_text_witness.title_and_colophon: HS00 and HS30 are represented in docs/STATUS.md and the proof sources but excluded from this 262-codepoint body file.
adopted_text_witness.edition_status: Project-adopted Japanese-style received witness; not the exact Taisho T251 body, not a named Japanese edition, and not a critical edition
variant_policy: HS22 reads 遠離一切顛倒夢想. The pinned CBETA running text reads 遠離顛倒夢想; added 一切 accounts for 262 rather than 260 body codepoints.
Mantra differences from CBETA running text: 帝 to 諦 four times, 般羅 to 波羅 twice, 莎婆 to 薩婆 once. None changes length.
At 0848c22 the apparatus distinguishes CBETA 莎婆, Taisho 僧莎, and Song/Yuan/Ming 薩婆. CBETA's edited running text is not identical to the Taisho witness.
Punctuation and spacing are editorial and are excluded from theorem-bearing character counts.
